messages.subject: Re: question re mirt package
parts:
You can use itemplot(), and then build your grid using functions from the gridExtra package. E.g.

mod <- mirt(Science, 2, TOL = 1e-1)
plot(gridExtra::arrangeGrob(itemplot(mod, 1), itemplot(mod, 2)))



Phil
